faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Senior Resident post is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Senior Resident position in this recruitment drive by PGIMER.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D. in Biochemistry and be registered with the Central or State Medical Council to be eligible for the Senior Resident position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per PGIMER rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email. The specific email address will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident post will be as per the Institute rules. Specific details regarding the pay scale can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or ad-hoc position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Senior Resident position is Ad-hoc, as indicated in the recruitment details.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
